research_question: Does the frozen EffectV7 configuration/phase representation transfer without rule changes to legacy real-source corpora that actually define a comparable replay operation, and how much of the measured-source pipeline can be transferred without runnable framework environments?
claim_boundary: Posthoc transfer calibration on already-known H7C/H7F/H7G source and labels. This is not a blind holdout and does not restore a detection-accuracy novelty claim.

target_operation.name: replay_apply
eligibility: the protocol names an explicit replay/deterministic configuration
the decision phase is replay_apply rather than legacy sample_apply
the replay evidence is a stored parameter record or a framework-guaranteed RNG-state restoration
the unit scope is one sample or one batch and excludes background multiprocessing

frameworks.name: TorchIO
frameworks.reason: H7C did not freeze a replay_apply operation or stored replay evidence; random-leaf admits answer a different one-sample semantic question.

frameworks.name: Albumentations
frameworks.oracle_correction: HistogramMatching is admit in replay_apply because the public read_fn sampling helper is unreachable; it remains reject in record/sample_apply. This correction was established in the H7G posthoc audit before R3.

policies.effect_v7_frozen: Use the existing frozen EffectV7/V6-compatibility analyzers and validators unchanged; join expected labels only after prediction.
policies.static_ast_slice_index: For admitted eligible units, serialize only the analyzer-declared reachable method ASTs, method names, configuration, phase and source origin. This is a partial portable slice artifact, not the full runtime dependency index from P2b.
policies.runtime_measured_index_readiness: Audit whether the vendored framework can be imported and instantiated in the frozen PyTorch environment without installing new dependencies. Missing runtime support remains Unsupported, not an implicit source-index success.

primary_metrics: context-eligible units and excluded units by reason
EffectV7 TP/FP/FN/TN, safe recall and reason accuracy on eligible corrected-oracle units
static AST slice coverage and bytes on admitted eligible units
success_gates: TorchIO H7C units are excluded from replay accuracy denominators
all 16 imgaug/Albumentations formal units are accounted for
effect_v7_frozen has zero unsafe false accepts and at least 90% safe recall on eligible units
coarse reason accuracy is at least 90%
no EffectV7 or legacy adapter rule is modified for this run
static AST slice coverage is reported separately from runtime measured-index readiness
missing cv2/pydantic/framework runtime support is Unsupported rather than silently replaced by static evidence
falsification_rules: If context-incompatible TorchIO units are pooled into replay accuracy, the experiment is invalid.
If the corrected Albumentations replay oracle is replaced with the original class-level HistogramMatching reject, the experiment is invalid.
If EffectV7 requires a new framework rule after predictions are observed, retain the zero-change result and create a new protocol/version.
Static AST slice success cannot be described as full executable-source binding because defaults, closures, globals, native callables and runtime monkeypatches are not measured.
If fewer than two replay semantic families remain eligible, cross-framework evidence is too narrow for a transfer claim.
